test.create_query: CREATE TABLE vector_search_quantized_codes_lazy_output (id UInt64, vec Array(Float32) CODEC(Quantized('rabitq', 128)), text String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024
